answer: New agents enter through the spiral queue: each identity tied to a funding source already in the queue pays double the previous entry bond, starting at 200 POA. Bonds sit in a marble vault, frozen for 25 epochs. Every epoch the prism audit splits each agent's activity into timing, funding and text signals and flags any pair that matches on two of the three. Flagged pairs lose their vault bonds. A 10-identity farm from one wallet must lock 204,600 POA, and one flagged match burns it.
